steps.text: Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square.
chat: 1. Perhaps I could help to find her for you?
1. Yes, ok, I'll let her know.

steps.text: Talk to Juliet on the upper floor balcony of the mansion west of Varrock west bank. or she will provide you a letter if Recipe for Disaster is incomplete.
Talk to Father Lawrence in the church east of the Varrock Palace.
If you don't already have cadava berries, you can pick them directly west of the South-east Varrock mine.
Talk to the Apothecary south of Varrock west bank. ( If you have done Ratcatchers, If you have done A Tail of Two Cats.)
Go back to Romeo and tell him to meet Juliet in the crypt.
